title: Power
summary: Every building draws power. The ⚡ readout shows what you make against what you want.
text:
Nearly everything in the colony runs on power. The **⚡** readout shows the power being made against the power wanted, in MW. It turns amber when you're drawing on the batteries and red when the cryo bank itself is going short.

The Command Core makes a little power, not even enough for the cryo bank. Your first **Solar Array** fixes that by day.

Ways to make power:

- **Solar Array**: cheap, strong at noon, almost nothing at night
- **Battery Bank**: stores spare power by day for the night
- **Geothermal Tap**: steady, day and night, but only on a vent
- **Tidal Generator**: a little steady power, out on the water
- **Fusion Cell**: heavy, steady power that burns isotopes

Staff help too: Technicians working at a solar array make it give more.
